create_bernoulli_distribution: create a Bernoulli distribution with probs or logits parameter for binary outcome modeling
sample_bernoulli: sample binary outcomes from a Bernoulli distribution using a PRNG key
compute_log_prob_bernoulli: compute the log probability of observed binary values under a Bernoulli distribution
compute_kl_divergence_bernoulli: compute the KL divergence between two Bernoulli distributions for model comparison
compute_entropy_bernoulli: compute the entropy of a Bernoulli distribution to measure outcome uncertainty
